test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is in geographical proximity to Sri Lanka?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only Karaikal**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Karaikal is the Union Territory in India that is closest to Sri Lanka.**
 
• It is** located on the southeastern coast of India,** just across the Palk Strait from Sri Lanka.
 
• Yanam, Mahe, and Puducherry (which is not listed in the options) are the other Union Territories of India,
 
 
• but they are located on the eastern and southern coasts of India, respectively, and are not in close proximity to Sri Lanka.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ec8ba1a8f33bfef62d01723bd4992e003894b901ea7664bb48e50c3caa22a3a.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Karaikal and Yanam**

 
 
• While Karaikal is indeed the closest Union Territory to Sri Lanka, Yanam is located on the eastern coast of India, near the Bay of Bengal.
 
• It is not geographically close to Sri Lanka.
 
 
 
• Mahe
 
• It is another Union Territory located on the western coast of India, near the Arabian Sea.
 
 
• It is also not geographically close to Sri Lanka.
